select count(1) from ( SELECT SEM.emp_name,SEM.user_type,SEM.org_code,SEM.org_name,SEM.org_code_path, SEM.org_name_path,sop.EMPLOYEE_CODE AS emp_no,sepc1.car_infos, sepc1.lock_cars, sop.FACTORY_ID factory_code,sop.update_time,sop.REMARK FROM safety_park_employee_power_history sop LEFT JOIN safety.safety_employee_message sem ON sem.emp_no = sop.EMPLOYEE_CODE LEFT JOIN (SELECT employee_no, GROUP_CONCAT( sepc.car_no ) car_infos, GROUP_CONCAT( CASE WHEN lock_flag = '是' THEN car_no END ) lock_cars FROM safety.safety_employee_private_car sepc GROUP BY employee_no) sepc1 ON sop.EMPLOYEE_CODE = sepc1.employee_no WHERE 1 = 1
) CUR_TABLE
mapper.insert:
insert into safety_park_employee_power_history (EMPLOYEE_CODE, FACTORY_ID, REMARK, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME, factory_name, EMPLOYEE_NAME, DETAILS) values
(#{item.employeeCode},#{item.factoryId},#{item.remark},CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,#{item.factoryName},#{item.employeeName},#{item.details})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE EMPLOYEE_CODE = VALUES(EMPLOYEE_CODE), FACTORY_ID = VALUES(FACTORY_ID), REMARK = VALUES(REMARK), factory_name = VALUES(factory_name), EMPLOYEE_NAME = VALUES(EMPLOYEE_NAME), DETAILS = VALUES(DETAILS), update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
